name: symrepl
description: Replay symbolic-execution counterexamples (KLEE .ktest) under a real debugger (LLDB) — ADR-0003 decision 14, declarative zero-code adapter.

ktest.description: Path to the KLEE test case (.ktest) to replay.

target.description: Path to the debuggee binary (linked with -lkleeRuntest).

stopOnEntry.description: Stop the inferior at the entry point.

stopOnBranch.description: Stop at every traced conditional branch (default: sites record-and-continue, M1 parity).

scope.description: Branch-tracing scope: 'module' or a comma-separated list of function names.

timeout.description: Seconds before the run is aborted (off by default — interactive sessions have no global timeout).
